rows.grounds: compound of eka, aṃśa, and hīna; modifies dvāraṃ
sandhi-fused tan+mānaṃ; measure associated with that
accusative object modified by preceding compounds
past participle of vad, agreeing with dvāraṃ

items.question: Which measure of the pure door is declared here?
premises: Its measure is one part less.
items.inference: Therefore the declared pure door has a measure one part less.
uncertainties: The exact referent of tan in tan+mānaṃ is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: The pure door whose measure is one part less is stated here.
